title: Keep below the bar
description: Windows that would sit under a bar drawn over the top of the screen (sketchybar) are moved and sized to start below it.

settings.label: Keep windows below the bar
settings.text: macOS: a window that opens, zooms or is dragged under a bar drawn over a hidden menu bar (sketchybar) is moved down clear of it, its bottom edge kept; the layouts leave the bar free too. Needs Accessibility

settings.label: Bar height
settings.description: The strip kept free at the top of every display; 0 asks sketchybar for its own height.

why: moves windows out from under the bar
